content: INLINEFORM0 is less affected by the disparity in the general distribution of male and female words in the text. The disparity between the occurrences of the two genders means that text is more inclined to mention one over the other, so it can also be considered a form of bias. We report the ratio of occurrence of male and female words in the model generated text, INLINEFORM1 , as INLINEFORM2
